title: Evaluate the thresholded artifact mask
description: You compare sample predictions with available ground truth labels.

steps.description: You mark a sample as artifact when p_artifact is at least 0.5. Metrics are computed when labels_true exists and has a value other than None.
You count true positives, true negatives, false positives, and false negatives by comparing the two masks. The recorded counts are 960, 7890, 150, and zero respectively.

steps.question: Why does the recorded recall equal 1.0000 while precision is lower?
steps.answer: The recording has zero false negatives, so recall reaches 1.0000. Its 150 false positives reduce precision to 0.8649.

steps.description: You compute F1 from precision and recall and accuracy from all four counts. The recorded F1 is 0.9275 and accuracy is 0.9833.
